plan.interpretation: Orders will reserve stock through a new Inventory operation, reserve(orderId, items, idempotencyKey), before it charges the customer. A reservation covers every item of the order or none of them, and repeating a request with the same key returns the first reservation.

requirements.text: Every item of an order is reserved before the order is confirmed
When any item is short, nothing is reserved
requirements.test: reserves nothing when one item is short

requirements.text: Retrying the same request does not reserve stock twice
requirements.test: does not reserve twice for a repeated key

requirements.text: The caller is told which items are unavailable
